doc.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

chapter: Chicago and the Stuff Smith trio
title: Joe Glaser, Stuff Smith's agent
summary: Levy sends commissions to the agent Joe Glaser, who could not enter Chicago, and gains his respect; Glaser's roster of artists.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Wrong city to come to, right?

Yeah. So he said, “you talk to this guy on the phone, and you know, you make sure you send him his commissions. And when you collect the money you pay off everybody and you send him his commissions.” So that’s how I got to know Joe Glaser, through this. And so right on time the commissions were sent and everything was taken care of. So I developed an excellent relationship with this top agent. He was one of the top agents.
Was he doing Louis Armstrong at that time?

Louis Armstrong, Dizzy, you name it. Especially trumpet players. He had Red Allen and Higginbotham and that group, the Dixieland groups. He had control over all of these different groups — Billie Holiday and you name it — Dinah Washington, he had all of these people. And so I got to know him first by just sending, make sure I sent that commission into him. So he sort of got a respect for me as a business person. So in 1944
